$note: Loops play muted inside the wing arches (3:4, made with tools/media/gif_to_loop.py, an MP4 and a WebM twin); null keeps the poster. "hold" (seconds) is where a loop rests after playing once per visit (WCAG 2.2.2); without it the loop rests on its last frame. Films live on YouTube: links everywhere, played in place on the web build only (Artifacts cannot embed other sites). A film's "asset" is its URL in the Artifact's asset store (upload the MP4 to the published Artifact); with it the Artifact plays the film in its own popup instead of linking out.
